delegation-talking-to-noah-or-alina.speaker: Alina
delegation-talking-to-noah-or-alina.text: Yes! They call it Varlamore, the Shining Kingdom! It's meant to be one of the most beautiful places in the world!
If the player is on a free-to-play world:

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: Oh, nothing you need to worry about.

delegation-talking-to-noah-or-alina.text: If the player is on a member's world:

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: Oh, hello! Are you here to see the delegation?

steps.speaker: Noah
steps.text: See! It's not just me who doesn't know what's happening.

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: The delegation from Varlamore, of course! After all these years, they're finally opening up the kingdom for travel and trade! Isn't it exciting?

steps.speaker: Noah
steps.text: Why would I be excited about a place I never even knew existed?

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: A whole land locked off for hundreds of years! Do you not want to be one of the first outsiders to step foot there? Think of the adventure!

steps.speaker: Noah
steps.text: Adventure? Sounds dangerous. I'll be staying right here, thank you very much!

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: Bah! Boring! What about you, stranger?

steps.prompt: Start the Children of the Sun quest?

steps.player: Well I'm actually something of an adventurer myself.

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: That's the spirit! I bet you'll want to be one of the first to head over to Varlamore!

options.text: What can you tell me about Varlamore?

steps.player: What can you tell me about Varlamore?

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: It's far across the western sea, over the mountains south of Great Kourend. Between the sea and the mountains, it's totally isolated! No one is allowed to come or go without good reason.

steps.speaker: Noah
steps.text: Sounds like a prison.

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: Quite the opposite! It's a beautiful and prosperous kingdom, ruled over by the Sun Queen!

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: Yes! She rules from her palace in their capital, Civitas illa Fortis. The sun plays an important role in Varlamorian life. In fact, they worship it!

steps.speaker: Noah
steps.text: What... the sun?

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: That's right! They have their own religion over there dedicated to the sun and the moon. Isn't that fascinating?

steps.speaker: Noah
steps.text: I don't know... It all sounds a bit odd to me.

options.text: How come you know so much about Varlamore?

steps.player: How come you know so much about Varlamore?

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: A while back, a group of travellers came through here, on their way to the dark lands of Morytania. They said they were from the College of Bards!

steps.speaker: Noah
steps.text: College of Bards?

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: Yes! It's found in the floating city of Tempestus! Members of the College are some of the only people allowed to travel to and from Varlamore.

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: They stayed the night in the Blue Moon Inn and spent hours telling us all about their homeland. I've been dying to visit ever since!

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: Well it should be any time now!

steps.speaker: Noah
steps.text: Hang on... what's going on over there?

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: Wait! That's them! They're here!

The scene begins with King Roald, Aeonisig Raispher, and two Varrock guards standing beside the square fountain. On the far side, the delegation can be seen approaching the king, which consists of Prince Itzla Arkan, Servius, Teokan of Ralos, Furia Tullus, Ennius Tullus, and six Knights of Varlamore.

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: There they are: The children of the sun! That's Itzla Arkan, heir to the throne of Varlamore! And there's Servius, the Teokan of Ralos!

steps.speaker: Noah
steps.text: Teokan? What's a Teokan?

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: It means High Priest. He's the religious leader in Varlamore.

steps.speaker: Noah
steps.text: Huh...
A guard with a big bag walks out of Varrock Castle.

steps.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
steps.text: What are you doing with that bag?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Oh... Er... Just delivering some supplies to the guards at the gates.

steps.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
steps.text: Well hurry back. We need everyone at their posts.
The guard walks past Alina, Noah, and the player.

steps.speaker: Noah
steps.text: That's an unusually big bag he's carrying.

steps.player: Hmm... Now where might you be going with that...?

steps.text: (Player begins tailing the guard.)

options.text: Sorry, but I need to head off.

steps.player: Sorry, but I need to head off.

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: Fair enough.

steps.player: I'm not sure. Doesn't really sound like my kind of thing.

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: Well... suit yourself, I guess.

delegation-subsequent-dialogues-before-s.speaker: Alina
delegation-subsequent-dialogues-before-s.text: A whole land locked off for hundreds of years! Do you not want to be one of the first outsiders to step foot there? Think of the adventure!

delegation-subsequent-dialogues-before-s.speaker: Noah
delegation-subsequent-dialogues-before-s.text: Adventure? Sounds dangerous. I'll be staying right here, thank you very much!

delegation-subsequent-dialogues-before-s.speaker: Alina
delegation-subsequent-dialogues-before-s.text: Bah! Boring! What about you, stranger?

delegation-subsequent-dialogues-before-s.prompt: Start the Children of the Sun quest?

delegation-subsequent-dialogues-after-st.text: If the player is on a free-to-play world:

steps.speaker: [Noah/Alina]
steps.text: Sorry, I can't stop to talk right now.

delegation-subsequent-dialogues-after-st.text: If the player is on a member's world:

steps.speaker: Alina
steps.text: Hello again! So what do you think? Reckon you'll be one of the first to head over to Varlamore?

options.text: What can you tell me about Varlamore?
How come you know so much about Varlamore?
Sorry, but I need to head off.

investigation-tailing-the-guard.text: If the player is spotted by the guard:

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: Hey! What are you doing?
You failed to stay hidden from the guard.

investigation-tailing-the-guard.text: If the player is too far from the guard:

steps.text: You failed to stay close enough to the guard.

investigation-talking-to-noah-or-alina-a.speaker: Noah
investigation-talking-to-noah-or-alina-a.text: That was quite a large bag that guard was carrying. I wonder where he's taking it...

investigation-successfully-following-the.text: A cutscene begins. The player listens in on four bandits and the guard from a window outside the building.

investigation-successfully-following-the.player: What are you up to in there...?

investigation-successfully-following-the.speaker: Guard
investigation-successfully-following-the.text: I'm here aren't I? If you're not happy, maybe you should have been the one to steal the uniforms!

investigation-successfully-following-the.speaker: Bandit (woman)
investigation-successfully-following-the.text: Enough! We don't have much time. Do you have everything?

investigation-successfully-following-the.speaker: Bandit (bearded)
investigation-successfully-following-the.text: We're just going to have to make do. The delegation is already in the palace. We need to be ready to strike as they leave.

investigation-successfully-following-the.speaker: Bandit (tanned)
investigation-successfully-following-the.text: Indeed. You all know the target. Get changed quick and be ready to take your positions.

investigation-successfully-following-the.speaker: Guard
investigation-successfully-following-the.text: Good luck. You're going to need it.

investigation-successfully-following-the.speaker: Bandit (bearded)
investigation-successfully-following-the.text: You lot panic too much. It's going to be fine. Now, let's get going.

investigation-successfully-following-the.player: This doesn't sound good. I'd better let that sergeant know.

investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn.player: Wait! I have some information that you need to hear.
There are some bandits disguising themselves as guards! I think they're planning to attack the delegation from Varlamore!
It's true! One of them infiltrated your guards and stole some uniforms. He came right through here earlier with them.

investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn.text: The one with the large bag? I thought I didn't recognise him, but then it's so hard to keep up. We get through guards so quickly around here for some reason...

investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn.player: So what do we do? Should we warn the delegation?

investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn.text: And risk a panic? No. Better we deal with this now while they're safe in the palace. Do you know how many bandits there are?

investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn.text: Right, we can work with that. You get out there and point them out. With them being disguised, you'll need to keep a close eye out for any guard who looks or acts differently to the others.

investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn.text: Don't go too far. If the bandits intend to attack the delegation, they'll either be here in the square or on the eastern road between the square and the bank.

investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn.text: Return to me once you've found all four and we'll take them all at the same time.

investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn-.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn-.text: Get out there and point out the four bandits. They're in disguise, so be sure to keep a close eye out for any guard who looks or acts differently to the others.

investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn-.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn-.text: Remember, if they intend to attack the delegation, they'll either be here in the square or on the eastern road between the square and the bank.

investigation-marking-a-guard.text: If four guards are already marked:

steps.text: You've already marked enough guards.

investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn-.player: Alright, I've pointed out all the bandits.

investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn-.text: If the player incorrectly marked any guards:

steps.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
steps.text: Are you sure? I definitely recognise at least one of them as one of my guards. Maybe you should try again.

investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn-.text: If the player correctly marked all four bandits:

steps.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
steps.text: Good work. I'll signal my guards to bring them in...
Sergeant Tobyn signals to his guards and the bandits are quickly arrested.

steps.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
steps.text: That could have ended up quite nasty if not for you. Once again, good work.

steps.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
steps.text: The bandits will be interrogated. If all goes well, we'll get some useful information out of them.

steps.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
steps.text: Speaking of which... given it was you who found them in the first place, you might be able to offer some support. Would you be willing to help?

steps.player: Of course! Where do you need me?

steps.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
steps.text: Come with me. We'll use the cell on the palace roof for the interrogations. It's nice and out of the way.
Sergeant Tobyn escorts you to the palace roof.

investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn-.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
investigation-talking-to-sergeant-tobyn-.text: That could have ended up quite nasty if not for you. Once again, good work.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Ah, nilsal, sergeant.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Prince Itzla! I... I'm sorry, but I wasn't expecting you here.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Well all that politics downstairs was getting a bit dry, but then I heard there'd been a bit of a commotion. I thought I'd come see what the fuss was all about. You don't mind, do you?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Well no, it's just...

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Wonderful! And you! Who are you?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: [player name]? Kuaini! Pleased to meet you. Crown Prince Itzla Arkan, heir to the Sun Throne, at your service.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Tell me, [player name], are you the one who caught these would-be assassins?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Well then, why don't you and I ask this one a few little questions. You don't mind, do you, sergeant?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Not at all, but...

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Excellent! Let's get started then.
The player and Prince Itzla enter one of the bandits' cells.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Nilsal to you, iknami. I hear you managed to get yourself into a spot of bother.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Bandit
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: I'm not telling you anything.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Ah, tetamo! Such a shame. No matter though! We'll have you talking in no time.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Now, you'll need to forgive me, but I'm a bit new around here, so your customs are not familiar to me. Tell me, iknami, what's the preferred method of interrogation in these parts?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Bandit
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: You're asking me how you should interrogate me?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Well it just seemed polite to ask. We have all sorts of fun methods back home in Varlamore. We could give one or two of them a go if you want?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Bandit
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: If I want?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Absolutely! Now, what are your thoughts on chicken?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Bandit
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Chicken?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Oh, [player name], do you not have chickens here? Sorry, again, all this is quite new to me.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.player: Yes, we have chickens. The farms around here have loads.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Well then, why the confusion? Have you never seen one before? Oh you poor sheltered thing. Did your parents never show you the wonders of the countryside?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Bandit
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: I know what a chicken is!

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Well why didn't you say so?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Bandit
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: I don't know what game you're playing, but it won't work on me!

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: No game at all, iknami. The reason I ask is because one of our preferred methods in Varlamore involves just a small amount of fire, and you'd never believe it, but the smell of human flesh once it gets going...

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Bandit
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: You're going to cook me?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Cook? No, not at all! That would imply I'm going to eat you, and I'm not a barbarian! Though, it would be interesting to know if it tastes like chicken as well...

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Bandit
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Alright, enough! I'll tell you what you want!

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Kuaini!

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: So who are you working for?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Bandit
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: I don't know their name. They just paid us to attack the delegation. They didn't look to be from around here. I reckon it was one of your lot!

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Why did they want you to attack the delegation?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Bandit
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: They didn't say, but that priest... he was the target!

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: So a Varlamorian paid you to assassinate the Teokan? You're not giving me much to go on.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Bandit
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: That's all I know!

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Hmm...

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Well I think we're done here. Come, [player name].
The player and Prince Itzla leave the cell.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: I think we got what we needed there.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: You're sure he told you everything?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Oh yes. The fear of being cooked will do that to a person. All total rubbish of course! Imagine burning someone alive! We're much more civilised over in Varlamore.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: We just cut out their heart while it's still beating instead.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.player: I can't tell if you're joking or not...

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Anyway, sounds like there'll be some work to do when we get back home. An assassination attempt on the Teokan of Ralos... Concerning stuff. First up though, I'd better get back to the politics!

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: [player name], once we've got these papers signed, you lot will be free to travel to Varlamore for the first time! No more needing explicit permission. You can come and go as you please!

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Now, it's entirely up to you of course, but given we have you to thank for stopping this plot, I'd be very keen if you'd join me in Varlamore to continue the investigation.
Before the release of Varlamore:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: No need to decide now. It will take a bit longer for us to be ready for visitors anyway, but when the time comes, I'll have my people send word to you.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: After the release of Varlamore:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: No need to decide now, but if you do wish to accept my offer, just speak to Regulus Cento outside the eastern gates of this city.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Now, they'll be missing me downstairs. Timoiva, and may the sun light your way!
Itzla departs.

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Well, that was interesting...

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.player: Not every day the heir to a far-off land comes and interrogates one of your prisoners?

interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.speaker: Sergeant Tobyn
interrogation-talking-to-the-prince-or-s.text: Oddly enough, no. This will be an interesting report to write. And on that note, I'd best get to it. All the best, adventurer. Thank you for your help.
Congratulations! Quest complete!

interrogation-talking-again-after-finish.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
interrogation-talking-again-after-finish.text: I think we got what we needed there.
